The '''father''' of [[Dynba Tesc]] was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. When she crafted [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] slogans and graphics, Tesc made sure that they hit her father's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] first, known that he would react with anger.<ref name="MC" />
